@router.post("/sso/saml/{org_id}/jit-provision")
async def jit_provision_saml_user(
    org_id: str,
    request: Request = None,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)
):
    req_data = await prepare_fastapi_request_for_saml(request)
    auth = OneLogin_Saml2_Auth(req_data, await get_saml_settings_for_org(org_id, db))
    auth.process_response()

    if auth.get_errors():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="SAML response failed validation")

    name_id = auth.get_nameid()
    attributes = auth.get_attributes()
    saml_roles = attributes.get("urn:oid:roles", ["MEMBER"])
    assigned_role = "ADMIN" if "SSO_ADMIN" in saml_roles else "MEMBER"

    new_user = User(
        email=name_id,
        org_id=org_id,
        role=assigned_role,
        is_active=True
    )
    db.add(new_user)
    await db.commit()

    return {"status": "provisioned", "user_email": name_id, "role": assigned_role}
